after.tests/test_contacts.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows


def make(sid, last, first, section, email="x@y.org"):
    return Student(sid, last, first, section, email)


class ContactRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    # ---
    def test_rows_are_sorted_by_name(self):
        rows = contact_rows([
            make("2", "Zed", "Al", "B", "al@z.org"),
            make("1", "Abe", "Bo", "A", "bo@a.org")
        ])
        self.assertTrue(rows[0].startswith("Abe, Bo"))
        self.assertTrue(rows[1].startswith("Zed, Al"))

    # ---
    def test_columns_line_up(self):
        rows = contact_rows([
            make("1", "Li", "Jo", "A", "jo@li.org"),
            make("2", "Longname", "Ann", "B", "a@b.org")
        ])
        col = rows[0].index("A")
        self.assertEqual(rows[1].index("B"), col)
        self.assertEqual(
            rows[0].index("jo@li.org"),
            rows[1].index("a@b.org")
        )

    # ---
    def test_missing_email_names_the_student(self):
        students = [
            make("1", "Abe", "Bo", "A"),
            make("2", "Cruz", "Dee", "A", None)
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError) as ctx:
            contact_rows(students)
        self.assertIn("Cruz, Dee", str(ctx.exception))

    # ---
    def test_blank_email_is_missing(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([make("1", "Abe", "Bo", "A", " ")])

    # ---
    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
